tools.description:
WHAT: Read open items. Amounts are in the base currency. overdue_amount counts only items past their due date; credit notes that are not yet due reduce open_amount but not overdue_amount, so overdue_amount can exceed open_amount. totals sums every matching item, not just the returned page. For creditors, amounts we owe are negative; positive amounts are prepayments or credit notes. Rows are sorted largest balance first. item_id identifies the open item (optional input for propose_reminder). A foreign-currency item whose exchange rate cannot be resolved has rate_unavailable true and amount_base null, and is left out of the base-currency sums (counted in rate_unavailable_items).
READS: openpost and adresser. WRITES: nothing.
IRREVERSIBILITY: none (read).
PRECONDITIONS: debtors.read or creditors.read; the requested branch and referenced records must be authorized and exist.
SAFE FALLBACK: explain the failure and ask a person to inspect the relevant Saldi screen.
NEXT STEP: use the returned citations to inspect records or prepare an approval proposal.
